Dear Michael,

I'm sorry to hear that the espresso machine in your package is damaged. To assist you with the next steps, please follow these instructions:

1. Contact our customer service team at [support@coffee.com](mailto:support@coffee.com) to report the damage and request a replacement or repair.
2. Please provide a clear photo of the damaged machine and any other relevant details about the issue.
3. We will review your request and get back to you with the best course of action.

If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out. Thank you for your patience, and we look forward to getting this sorted out for you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

Let me know if you need any further assistance or if there's anything else I can do for you!
